# `forge` command-line reference

Headless Forge3D: scenes, commands and export.

`forge-studio --headless <args>` runs the same tool. Add `--json` to any subcommand for one JSON object on stdout (`{"ok": true, ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message"}}`); messages go to stderr.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | user error: bad arguments, unknown command id or node, a command that refuses, a failed script or RPC call |
| 2 | the scene file cannot be read or loaded |
| 3 | internal error (a bug) |

## Global options

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | no |  | Machine output: one JSON object on stdout, messages on stderr |

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`new`](#forge-new) | Write an empty scene |
| [`info`](#forge-info) | Show the node tree |
| [`validate`](#forge-validate) | Load the scene and build every node |
| [`eval`](#forge-eval) | Evaluate a frame, report geometry, optionally export it |
| [`export`](#forge-export) | Export the scene evaluated at a frame |
| [`cmd`](#forge-cmd) | Run one command on a scene file |
| [`commands`](#forge-commands) | List the command registry with argument schemas |
| [`docs`](#forge-docs) | Write the generated reference (commands, CLI, RPC, MCP, scripting) as markdown |
| [`run`](#forge-run) | Run a Rhai script on a scene (docs/specs/SCRIPTING.md) |
| [`rpc`](#forge-rpc) | Call a method of a running editor over JSON-RPC (docs/specs/RPC.md) |
| [`render`](#forge-render) | Render an image (not available yet) |

### `forge new`

Write an empty scene

```
forge new <path> [--force]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<path>` | yes |  |  |
| `--force` | no |  | Overwrite an existing file |

### `forge info`

Show the node tree

```
forge info <scene>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<scene>` | yes |  |  |

### `forge validate`

Load the scene and build every node

```
forge validate <scene>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<scene>` | yes |  |  |

### `forge eval`

Evaluate a frame, report geometry, optionally export it

```
forge eval <scene> [--frame] [--node] [--export]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<scene>` | yes |  |  |
| `--frame` | no | `0` |  |
| `--node` | no |  |  |
| `--export` | no |  |  |

### `forge export`

Export the scene evaluated at a frame

```
forge export <scene> [--format] --out [--selected] [--frame]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<scene>` | yes |  |  |
| `--format` | no | `obj` |  |
| `--out` | yes |  |  |
| `--selected` | no |  | Only these node ids (and their descendants), comma separated |
| `--frame` | no | `0` |  |

### `forge cmd`

Run one command on a scene file

```
forge cmd <scene> <command> [--args] [--save]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<scene>` | yes |  |  |
| `<command>` | yes |  |  |
| `--args` | no | `{}` | JSON object with the command arguments |
| `--save` | no |  | Write the changed scene back to the file |

### `forge commands`

List the command registry with argument schemas

```
forge commands [--markdown]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--markdown` | no |  | Print the command reference as markdown instead |

### `forge docs`

Write the generated reference (commands, CLI, RPC, MCP, scripting) as markdown

```
forge docs [--out] [--check]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out` | no | `docs/manual/reference` | Directory to write (default: docs/manual/reference) |
| `--check` | no |  | Write nothing; fail (exit 1) if the files in --out differ from the generated ones |

### `forge run`

Run a Rhai script on a scene (docs/specs/SCRIPTING.md)

```
forge run <script> [--scene] [--save]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<script>` | yes |  |  |
| `--scene` | no |  | Scene to run on (default: an empty scene) |
| `--save` | no |  | Write the resulting scene here (a plain run is a dry run) |

### `forge rpc`

Call a method of a running editor over JSON-RPC (docs/specs/RPC.md)

```
forge rpc <method> [--params] [--port] [--token]
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<method>` | yes |  |  |
| `--params` | no |  | JSON object with the method parameters |
| `--port` | no |  | Editor port (default: FORGE_RPC_PORT, the settings file, then 7323) |
| `--token` | no |  | Token (default: FORGE_RPC_TOKEN or the settings file). Visible in `ps` |

### `forge render`

Render an image (not available yet)

```
forge render
```

No options.
